data_fields.name: follow_start_distance
data_fields.donor_constant: 2.0 m (MinDistance); also the MoveToObject stop distance

data_fields.name: despawn_distance
data_fields.donor_constant: 192.0 m (MaxDistance); donor fixed, proposed per zone

data_fields.name: spawn_offset_extra
data_fields.donor_constant: owner physics radius + pet radius + 2.0 m (MinDistance)

data_fields.name: device_charges
data_fields.donor_constant: Structure per summon device, one spent per summon, refused at 0

best_idea: A companion stands within 2 m of its owner, walks back only when farther than 2 m, and is removed server-side when the owner is more than 192 m away or gone, checked once a second on a timer inside a 0.2 s tick.
decision_why: A follow-and-leash companion for hero allies in open zones is useful; the donor's missing return after its despawn is a real defect (fixed in the sketch) and the 192 m despawn should be zone data rather than a constant; the summon charge rules are not needed for Frankendom now.
acceptance: In an open zone, a companion stays about 2 m from its hero, walks back once the hero is more than 2 m away, and the server removes it when the hero is more than 192 m away or gone; a server test asserts that a despawn never starts a follow.
